status: "construct fixture (spec: Sections) - a ## heading that is not in a title-card run is a section break (part, act, chapter): it closes the open screen, never draws on a slide, and the ### heading after it leads the next screen in the handout. ## lines right after a shot (or at the top of the file) are title-card text and stay on screen. ## Movement N is the numbered spelling of the same thing. The printed label is always ordinal-dot-title, with any Movement|Part|Act|Chapter|Section N prefix dropped (a bare prefix leaves Section N)."
